title: Wavetable Synthesizer
text: Generate periodic signal from single-cycle waveforms, 4 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Single-cycle waveform} sets the wavetable sin, {Output wave frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of generated signal, {Output wave amplitude} sets the amplitude of generated signal, {Output wave phase offset} sets the normalized phase offset of generated, {Output wave DC offset} sets the value added to each element of generated, {Samples per frame} sets the number of samples per frame output, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of generated signal, {Output data type} sets the data type of generated and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: WT
ports.summary: Single-cycle waveform vector of real values

ports.name: F
ports.summary: Output wave frequency (Hz) nonnegative scalar | vector of nonnegative values

params.name: Single-cycle waveform
params.values: Wavetable sin(2*pi*(0:511)/512) (default) | vector of real values

params.name: Output wave frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of generated signal 100 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Output wave amplitude
params.values: Amplitude of generated signal 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Output wave phase offset
params.values: Normalized phase offset of generated signal 0 (default) | scalar in the range [0,1]

params.name: Output wave DC offset
params.values: Value added to each element of generated signal 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Number of samples per frame output from block 512 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of generated signal 44100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of generated signal double (default) | single

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
